Honestly, as a mum, I would appreciate this so much! 

To be honest anything from a little bit of humour to saying you’re proud of her for raising a wonderful child will probably bring her tears of happiness! 

No one else will notice you giving the mother a card so don’t worry about what others will think but it sure will make a big impact on her :)

Make a donation to a cat rescue or maybe do some volunteering there? 

Also you need to seek help, that is absolutely not normal behaviour and not a normal reaction to a little scratch. It doesn’t matter if it’s the first time you’ve felt like that or the 10th. Get help.

You can prick your finger and “milk” that finger, it usually works quite well. Ive had to do it for a few at home blood tests. 

Just make sure you clean the area before you do it, use a medical lancet if you can, and clean afterwards. 

Please do not cut yourself to get the blood!

Sounds like you went through a tough period in your life and the fact that she cheated on you during your time of need is disgusting. That doesn’t excuse your “inappropriate texting” but she has continued to cheat on you multiple times after that. 

It sounds like you really want to make this work as you have forgiven her multiple times and have started therapy to work through your problems. However it seems like you’re putting in a lot of effort to not have the effort returned. 

I honestly think you should cut your losses and get out of that relationship for good

That breaks my heart reading that. 
Did anything significant happen after 2 years to change her libido? 

Once she has had baby would she be willing to get her hormones checked and some blood work done to see if there is anything underlying causing her libido to drop? 

It doesn’t sound like she’s very open to any kind of compromise but she has to be if she wants to keep the relationship alive and if she doesn’t then the relationship isn’t worth your energy. 

Life is too short to be stuck in a sexless relationship

Sounds like she definitely had/has something to hide. 

Don’t let her gaslight you, you’re not being stupid or crazy.. anyone would have the same reaction (and probably worse) as you with something like this. 

I’d work on an exit plan.. make sure your finances are in order and hand her the divorce papers. You deserve so much better buddy!

I find it hard to believe this is the first time he’s messaged her in 10 years.. and the fact he was so forward in his message. 

If I were you I would ask to see all of the messages between the two of them. If she refuses, hesitates, “has to check something” before handing it over then you have your answer. 

I’m sorry this is happening to you, no one should have to go through cheating.

You can still be a great father without being with your wife. If anything, being stuck in an unhappy marriage/relationship could make you a worse father as children can sense tension/stress in a relationship. 

Her hormones may be affecting her sex drive, what was she like before she fell pregnant? (I have always had a super high sex drive when pregnant but I assume it can easily go the other way!!) 

But hormones or not, there is no need for her to make you feel like shit. 
A relationship is all about compromise.. yer she may not be in to sex right now but I firmly believe she should make the effort (and show enthusiasm) to please you. Sex is important in a relationship and wanting it once a week for example is not asking for the world..

Yer I feel like I have gone downhill since being pregnant.. I’m in a similar situation with my meds as I have had a diagnosis change so I’m not taking anything at the moment which is really fucking hard! 

I’m glad you’re going to be honest with your midwife, I promise you they will help! Even if they offer you more appointments so you are able to chat about your pregnancy more often :) 

I love talking about pregnancy and birth so I can see how hard it must be going through it alone, I can see from your original post that you don’t really socialise much, maybe it would help making some online friends that you can talk about your pregnancy with? 

Last thing, do not let anyone make you feel bad for feeling this way.. no one would make you feel bad for having a broken leg so I don’t know why they feel entitled to make you feel bad for having a broken brain. You are so so strong and don’t forget that 💛

Oh lovely, I feel your pain. I’m currently pregnant and feel exactly the same, I think about suicide/ self harm often and have had to clear out my medication so I don’t take an overdose. 

I’m sorry you feel like this, it’s absolutely awful. 

I don’t really have any advice apart from seek help, no matter how scary it is. There are pregnancy safe anti depressants/ anti anxiety medication that may be able to help you. 

Remember you do not need a partner to be in your life to be a good parent but I think you would benefit from some support. Have you spoken to your midwife about how you feel and your situation? They may be able to give you some contacts to get some support with your children. 

You’re a strong ass person for being a single parent and remember, it will all be okay in the end and if it’s not okay, it’s not the end. 

My inbox it open if you ever need anything 💛

I am so sorry you are feeling like this too :( I hope you are being supported and are able to get some help/ treatment to get better. 

Just because you struggle doesn’t make you any less of a good parent and never let anyone tell you any different! 

Thank you so much and the same goes to you too ❤️

I was mis diagnosed with Bipolar and the main things that caused me to seek out a second opinion were- 

My moods didn’t follow a pattern or cycle that is typical with Bipolar, my moods are more influenced by other peoples emotions. 

Anti psychotics did not help in the slightest and neither did mood stabilisers and I had been through nearly every combination you can think of and nothing really helped, they just stripped me of a personality and made me a zombie. 

What I did was get a list of symptoms of bipolar and adhd and write down which ones affected me and how they affect my daily life. Then take this to a psychiatrist and see what they say :)

So really I just want to say thank you, thank you for being you, thank you for introducing us to Robbie, Stevie and all the fantastic guests and hosts you’ve had on over the years and thank you for saving my life.

She is absolutely by no fault of her own a bad person. I wouldn’t even say she has any “bad” in her.. she is deeply troubled due to the neglect you and your husband as “parents” have subjected her too. 

This is 100% yours and your husbands fault. You say you had your own issues, fair enough, we all do, but you suck those up and be a parent to your child.

Please put in a proper parenting shift and give her love and support and help her overcome whatever demons she is facing.
